      Full job description

      • Full Time

      Description

      Looking to work at fun and dynamic software company? We’re a growing software company looking for an experienced Back End Developer to help build our next generation of software products. As a winner of the ‘Houston Best & Brightest Companies to Work for ‘, we place strong emphasis on offering a fun work-environment, healthy work-life balance of course, fun and challenging work.

      Responsibilities

      • Help create technical direction for the team
      • Solid understanding of REST API design methodologies using .Net Core 3.x (C#)
      • Extensive experience implementing responsive designs which work across platforms
      • Strong understanding of relational database design

      Benefits

      • Location Independent.
      • Competitive base salary with large bonus opportunities.
      • Little to no travel.
      • Fun and dynamic work culture – see our reviews on Glassdoor

      Requirements

      • 5+ years experience as a software developer with most recent experience in senior level position
